All shoes, insoles, towels, water marks, airflow marks, and all non-route connectors must use deep ink, white paper, or low-contrast gray only: never apply green, blue, cyan, or any other colour to them. Use brand green only on the two extremely thin directional arrows between the three states, with no other green marks anywhere on the page. Gray local leaders support exact labels. No heat source, fan, temperature mark, or product-style rendering.
